# Kuailu HR | Product Overview

Kuailu HR is an HR management system for employee master data, time and attendance, and compensation operations. The supplied operating manual describes the Employee, Time & Attendance, and Compensation modules as an integrated workflow.

| Product scope | Included capability |
| --- | --- |
| Employee management | Employee roster, pending onboarding, contracts, HR transaction documents and foundational settings |
| Time & Attendance | Attendance profiles and groups, shifts, scheduling, rules, leave & attendance forms, and reports |
| Compensation | Compensation profiles, social insurance and housing fund, individual income tax, payroll rules, payroll calculation, reports and payslips |
| Data relationship | Employee master data is the source for attendance and compensation records; completed workflows write results back to related records |
| Source scope | The supplied manual is labelled Mainland China; the sales-training deck also describes Hong Kong-oriented 468 / ADW / MPF capabilities. Regional availability must be confirmed for each deployment. |
